scope: Exhaustive finite authored story + typed inventory + current-run flags. Ordered rhythm histories are counted with BigInt, not individually printed. Representative exact journal paths are replay-checked.

forcedDeadEndStates.definition: Reachable nonterminal states with no future path to a regular or secret ending. Authored dead-end terminals themselves are intentional outcomes and are excluded.

quietVersusQuick.note: Secret eligibility is already committed by the stage2 promise. A stage9 inventory choice cannot invent the other promise.

braceVersusChart.firstMatchPriority: An answer ending half-rest sets brace even if it contains both grouped kinds.

additionalInventoryConstraint.note: The resource incompatibility is an additional fact; it does not imply both secret promises can coexist until step9.

exclusion.reason: Every reachable entry to this scene excludes this door’s flag requirements.
